messages:
Felix (Finance): billing-bot surfaced a mid-day GPU spend jump in project 'trial-workbench' — seeing a $9k pulse over 6 hours. dashboard: https://redwood.app/billing/trial-workbench @Sam @Ivy
billing-bot: ALERT: project=trial-workbench period=2026-07-11T10:00..16:00 gpu_cost=9,120usd delta=+320% vs baseline export=/billing/export?ts=1905000123
Sam (FinOps): can we map the top resources? need customer vs internal attribution before deciding credits
Ivy (CloudOps): fetching allocation. quick sample shows mix of labeled trial sessions and a bunch of owner-less interactive kernels spun up by the `workbench-runner` automation. sample:
```
resource_id,project,cost_usd,labels
wb-11,trial-workbench,4,320,customer=trial-omega;owner=;session=interactive
wb-19,trial-workbench,2,640,customer=;owner=workbench-runner;session=batch
wb-05,trial-workbench,2,160,customer=trial-alpha;owner=alice;session=interactive
```
Rosa (CS): trial-omega reported some flakiness earlier; they shouldn't be running heavy batch jobs. I'll ping the trial owner to confirm whether this is expected
Sam (FinOps): recommendation: provisional credit to trial-omega for labeled resources pending confirmation; unlabeled resources -> attempt 48h backfill then platform reserve if owners not found
Felix (Finance): approve provisional credit up to $4,500 for confirmed customers. also please add a budget alert for trial-workbench at 60% monthly spend
Ivy (CloudOps): applied temporary throttle for interactive sessions in trial-workbench and started a 48h backfill job. added deny rule for `workbench-runner` launching >8 GPUs in trial projects. patch: https://git.redwood/cloud/changes/8277
billing-bot: NOTE: provisional_credit created amount=4500usd case=CR-2109 notify=[felix@redwood.com,sam@redwood.com]
Sam (FinOps): will post full hourly mapping in 90m. follow-up: add CI lint to prevent `workbench-runner` from omitting owner tag in trial projects
Rosa (CS): reached out to trial owner; they confirmed only light interactive work. agreed to credit any unintended batch hours.
Felix (Finance): thanks. hold final invoice adjustment until backfill and trial-owner confirmation. add this incident to monthly billing anomalies report. :white_check_mark:
